thread:
Ava (Partnerships): quick sync — we need to get the first pass of the cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure) into staging this week. scope: trial SKU, short copy, pricing tier mapping, and one-click deploy artifacts. can someone take lead?
Raj (Product): I can own packaging and pricing mapping. will draft the SKU matrix today.
Ava (Partnerships): awesome. Raj — include recommended trial length and entitlements (API rate limits, dedicated vs hosted flags).
Raj (Product): will do. question: do we create a single SKU per cloud or one SKU with region/offer variants?
Miguel (CloudOps): prefer per-cloud SKUs for marketplace portals — simpler CI for AMI/container builds and region metadata. fewer surprises for listings.
Jo (Engineering): FYI the private deploy artefact names differ (onprem vs marketplace). I'll add a build target that produces marketplace-compatible tarball and a separate container manifest.
Tanya (Legal): I'll need the EULA snippet and partner contact info. also confirm whether the trial terms need local-language variants for EU.
Ava (Partnerships): good call. Raj — add an EULA placeholder field in the SKU matrix and mark EU localization required.
Raj (Product): noted. one more: pricing tiers — free trial tier vs paid starter vs enterprise. should we surface a metered usage field for tokens?
Miguel (CloudOps): yes — marketplace metering for tokens is awkward. for AWS/Azure we can expose a usage dimension (tokens) but the billing mapping happens off-platform. we should document both: 'marketplace-visible price' and 'internal metering flag'.
Jo (Engineering): quick tech note — AWS requires AMI IDs and role ARN for marketplace listing verification. I can provision a throwaway AMI in staging account and share IDs.
Ava (Partnerships): @marketplace-bot do we have the publisher account checklist link?
marketplace-bot: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/publisher-checklist — includes IAM role templates, screenshot specs, and listing copy guidelines :page_facing_up:
Ava (Partnerships): perfect. Tanya — can you review the compliance checklist for gov/reg markets?
Tanya (Legal): I'll skim today and flag anything that blocks publishing (data residency, audit logs, export controls). back with notes by EOD.
Raj (Product): I'll upload the SKU matrix to the checklist doc and add suggested tile copy and 3x screenshots.
Jo (Engineering): for screenshots — need standard sizes: 1280x720 and an architecture diagram. I can create a lightweight diagram.
Miguel (CloudOps): testing plan: we need one test account per cloud, pre-seeded with a sample token allowance and a dummy S3/GCS/Azure Blob integration to validate storage flows. I can spin these up but need names.
Ava (Partnerships): create accounts under naming convention redwood-marketplace-staging-<cloud>. Miguel — ping me with account creds in 1Password.
Miguel (CloudOps): will do.
Tanya (Legal): Clarification — do we need an export control statement for the EU listing? some clouds ask about crypto/export in questionnaire.
Ava (Partnerships): yes include non-export-restricted statement. Tanya — can you drop one-liner we can paste into the portal?
Tanya (Legal): "This product does not include cryptographic functionality beyond standard transport encryption and is compliant with applicable export control laws." will send as snippet.
Raj (Product): timeline check — if we get artifacts by Thu AM, can we get a staging publish by Thu EOD?
Jo (Engineering): engineering can produce artifacts by Thu AM. Miguel can do staging accounts by Thu noon. Tanya to finish review by Thu EOD.
Ava (Partnerships): OK — aim for staging publish Thu EOD. blockers: any legal hold, manual security review, or missing screenshots.
marketplace-bot: reminder: marketplace publisher accounts often trigger a manual verification step; plan +48h for portal review after submit.
Jo (Engineering): noted. I'll add CI job: `make marketplace-package && make publish-staging` and include a dry-run mode. snippet: ```bash
# dry-run
make marketplace-package DRY_RUN=1
```
Miguel (CloudOps): I'll add a deploy playbook and one-click smoke test: create instance, run healthcheck, request token generation.
Ava (Partnerships): owners: Raj -> packaging & copy, Jo -> artifacts/CI, Miguel -> staging infra, Tanya -> legal signoff. I'll coordinate portal submission and marketing blurb.
Raj (Product): adding owners to the checklist doc now.
Tanya (Legal): sending EULA snippet and export line now.
Ava (Partnerships): thanks all. will check in Fri AM for status and to schedule the portal submission window. :rocket:
